{"notes": "Visit 5 (7:45): Nobody spoke while I was there, and the picture has no hand labels, so I can't credit any domino to a person. Fish outline is still one connected dark line from the start, no pale pieces. Top and bottom lines both reach the tail tips (about x=27.5). Doubled/crowded dominoes remain at x=9-10 and along the back x=12-19, so it looks connected but is still a push risk. Nobody seems to have fixed it, though I can't tell who tried.

Maya: Not heard this visit. Earlier she said she'd review the run and shout on a break. Oversight only so far. What she built is unconfirmed. Ask her.

Leo: Not heard this visit. Earlier he took on checking the back and yielded the upper fork to Tom cleanly. The doubling along the back is still there, so I don't know whether he fixed it or tried. Ask him.

Priya: Not heard this visit. Earlier she confirmed connectivity and offered Tom help without crowding. Supportive, but what she placed is unconfirmed. Ask her.

Tom: Not heard this visit. Earlier he said the fish looks like a fish and he'd keep hands off and shout if anything tips. The upper fork is complete, but I can't verify he built it. Ask him privately.

No ratings yet. Before the push, get private input from all four on what each placed and fixed, and who worked on the doubled patches. Don't credit or penalize on assumption."}
